svg.title: FIG-04 静态实例与共享多态表 示例结构：两个同类实例 + controller / endpoint 分离 FIG-04 Static instances and shared ops reference layout; controller != endpoint
svg.desc: 应用：assembly-local typed ID application: assembly-local typed ID; typed factory 有界 switch → 既有 const face 非法 ID → NULL；不初始化、不分配 bounded lookup of an existing readonly face invalid ID -> NULL; no allocation or startup; 按配置选入的 UART 实例 UART instances selected by assembly; const UART face A ops* + context*; const UART face B ops* + context*; const 同模式 UART ops 同 provider 共享一份 one shared ops table per provider / mode; 私有 state A 独立 active 引用 / RX storage private state A: own active ref / RX storage; 私有 state B 独立 active 引用 / RX storage private state B: own active ref / RX storage; 总线身份：独立 factory 类与命名空间 separate controller and endpoint namespaces; SPI controller face 真正控制器状态 / recovery real controller state and recovery; SPI device endpoint face CS / mode / 频率 + controller 引用 CS / mode / frequency / controller reference; I2C 同样分开 controller 与 address endpoint I2C: controller != address endpoint; 查找（不是热路径每次调用） lookup, outside ordinary I/O hot path; 返回既有引用 existing face reference; 返回既有引用 existing face reference; 只读 ops 引用 readonly ops reference; 只读 ops 引用 readonly ops reference; 独立 context 引用 per-instance context; 独立 context 引用 per-instance context; 方法接收本次 context method receives this context; 方法接收本次 context method receives this context; controller ID; device ID; 实际总线引用 / admission actual controller reference / admission
